rawProofCommandBoundary: Hermetic in-memory proof only. It exercises USF local observability operations evidence with synthetic tenants, value-free telemetry, tenant-safe labels, redaction, PDP-protected operator surfaces, provider-mode posture, and explicit reclassification of live monitoring backends, SIEM export, alert delivery, dashboard runtime, incident workflow, retention purge, SLI/SLO operation, cross-tenant aggregate analytics, staging, production, SOC, ISO certification, full dev readiness, full product readiness, and USF-133 closure claims.
nonClaims: No full dev readiness, test readiness, staging readiness, production readiness, deployment readiness, live-provider readiness, SOC readiness, ISO certification, enterprise production readiness, full product readiness, or USF-133 closure claim is made.

Hermetic observability proof does not prove live telemetry backends, live monitoring backends, SIEM export, alert delivery, dashboard runtime, incident workflow operation, on-call process, status-page operation, SLO operation, or production monitoring.
Local tenant-safe telemetry and operator API proof does not prove Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, Alertmanager, Alloy, Sentry, or external observability provider readiness.
USF-159 reclassifies live/deep observability operations as outside the current dev-foundation source-issue acceptance unless a future issue explicitly authorises and proves them.

acceptanceCriteriaMapping.criterion: Each deferred observability backend or operation is implemented with proof or explicitly reclassified.
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.evidence: Controls below record proven-local evidence for local telemetry operations, credentials posture, tenant-safe labels, access, audit linkage, redaction, retention posture, and cross-tenant query denial. Live backends, SIEM export, alert delivery, dashboards, incident workflow, SLI/SLO operation, and cross-tenant aggregate analytics are explicitly reclassified as not proven and not claimed by USF-159.
provider-credential-boundary records secret-reference-only posture and the proof scans status output for secret and endpoint references.

acceptanceCriteriaMapping.criterion: Tenant-safe labels, redaction, retention, access, and audit evidence are proven where claimed.
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.evidence: make observability-proof records allow-listed labels, redaction before persistence, tenant query isolation, PDP-protected observability routes, value-free access audit, health/readiness/liveness separation, and retention/disposal non-equivalence.

acceptanceCriteriaMapping.criterion: Source-use and parity matrices remain truthful.
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.evidence: This matrix, the source-use matrix, gap register, functionality parity matrix, and scope classification matrix name USF-159 as bounded local proof plus explicit reclassification, not live observability readiness.

acceptanceCriteriaMapping.criterion: No live observability or incident readiness claim is made without proof.
acceptanceCriteriaMapping.evidence: claims object and proof result set live monitoring, backend, SIEM, alerting, dashboard, incident-response, staging, production, SOC, ISO certification, full-dev, full-parity, and USF-133 closure claims to false.

controls.nonClaimBoundary: Local redaction, access, audit, and retention posture is not production retention, legal hold, SIEM export, or incident-response readiness.

Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, Grafana, Alertmanager, Alloy, Sentry service ingestion, OpenTelemetry collector export, SIEM export, and external observability providers are not proven or claimed by USF-159.

Alert delivery, alert routing operation, dashboard runtime, incident workflow, on-call escalation, status-page operation, vulnerability workflow, corrective-action process, and post-incident review evidence are not proven or claimed by USF-159.
SLI/SLO posture is represented, but operational measurement, error-budget policy execution, live burn-rate alerting, and cross-tenant aggregate analytics are not proven or claimed by USF-159.

deferredBoundaries.nonClaimBoundary: No live observability backend, SIEM, Sentry service readiness, alert delivery, dashboard runtime, incident-response, staging, or production readiness claim is made by USF-159.
